evidence.quote:
No blocking
call, and no lost work

observations.why: Two negated clauses set in deliberate contrast within one frame — what is absent on each side of the comma crystallizes the contract's guarantee as matched opposition.

evidence.quote:
the agent either polls the run or
gets the reaction piggybacked on a later call

observations.why: Matched grammatical structure across two coordinated clauses (either … or …) laying out the two delivery paths in parallel form.
